**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve findings from every precision sweep**

When `--quality` is used and a precision fixture produces an unexpected finding, only the recall pass's `pass.findings` are classified here; `PrecisionFixtureRun` discards the precision findings, and the emitted precision summaries have no category attribution. The resulting sweep-on evidence therefore cannot attribute each precision finding to a category or `uncategorized`, and it records no independent per-category outcome for the precision request, contrary to AC9. Retain and classify each precision result's findings separately.
